- TTL-based automatic expiry
- Thread safety via locking
- Statistics tracking
- Configurable capacity and TTL
- Support for custom key hashing
- Integration with pytest for testing
"""

import threading

        value: The cached value
        created_at: Timestamp when entry was created
        expires_at: Timestamp when entry expires
        last_accessed: Timestamp of last access
        status: Current status of the entry
    """
